dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (JMA standard receipt software), compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux. Program ORCR0105 is part of the Japanese Medical Association open-source receipt billing system.
evidence: ORGANIZATION IS INDEXED ACCESS MODE IS DYNAMIC
no EXEC CICS / no EXEC SQL

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance receipt (レセプト) billing system — creates print files for medical insurance claim receipts (レセプト印刷用ファイル作成) for the national health insurance (国保/社保) system, handling various insurance combinations, disaster relief, and regional public expense billing.
purpose.summary: ORCR0105 generates output files for printing Japanese medical insurance claim receipts (レセプト). It processes patient insurance data, calculates claim points and co-payments across multiple insurance types (national health, social insurance, public expense subsidies), and writes formatted records for downstream printing. The program handles numerous special cases including disaster relief, elderly patient rules, and regional public expense variations.

notable_features: INDEXED file organization with DYNAMIC access (RECE02-FILE, RECE02X-FILE)
68 COPY statements indicating heavy use of shared copybooks
625 PERFORM statements indicating structured procedural logic
No COMP-3 usage (all numeric fields in display or binary)
Extensive Japanese-language comments in EUC-JP/latin-1 encoding
Very large single program (~584 KB, 12436 lines)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS — pure batch file I/O
verdict.notes: Source is encoded in EUC-JP decoded as latin-1, causing mojibake in Japanese comment text. The program is genuine production COBOL from the JMA ORCA open-source medical receipt system, maintained over many years (2008–2018). Truncated at 16000 chars; full file is ~584 KB with 12436 lines. No COMP-3 fields detected despite financial calculations — likely uses DISPLAY or BINARY numerics throughout.
